description: A one-to-nine multiple, passing polyphonic cables through unchanged

inputs.text: The signal copied to all nine outputs, clamped to -10V to 10V on the way

outputs.text: A copy of the input, clamped to -10V to 10V

notes: with the input unpatched every output is held at 0V on one channel
each output takes the channel count of the input, so a sixteen-channel cable in gives nine sixteen-channel cables out
the ninth output's tooltip reads 8th, which is the maker repeating the eighth jack's name
